notes.title: Fixed an error.
notes.notes: We fixed an error caused by an undefined character (OM)—My apologies for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Minor change to script at the start of the game.
notes.notes: I have fixed an error on my part that allowed skipping the game forward by a lot and added some text at the start of the game to notify players that although Alison Fall of the Apple is indeed a game with three separate paths with content... Only love (canon story) is completed. I do not want anyone to feel deceived by it. You can now decide whether the other two paths are worth your time.

notes.title: Alison fall of the Apple is coming to STEAM at the end of February
notes.notes: Many of you have asked me to make AFOTA available over the years. It is finally coming to STEAM at the end of this month.
